display_long_description:
Training system for medication education
•   Controller system (order display, object picking, drug mixing, patient administration) 
•   Order (medication order) system 
•   Evaluation system (operation accuracy, time, sequence, drug mix accuracy) 
•   Learning management and analysis system (training results, Excel log export, institutional statistics and reports) 
ㅇ Educational content
•   Tutorial: Basic VR operation and location-based tutorials 
•   Dosage 1.1 General drug administration 
•   Dosage 1.2 High-risk drug administration 
•   Medication 1.3 Emergency medication administration 
•   CJMM-based semi-emergency scenarios (patient assessment, judgment, intervention, evaluation) 
ㅇ System development
•   System advancement (UI/UX creation, medication order system, evaluation items) 
•   Divided into two modes (training mode, challenge mode) 
•   Pharmaceutical and medical device random placement system 
•   Medical device (vial, syringe, IV, etc.) label replacement system (brand, capacity, language) 
•   Multilingual system (Korean, Chinese, Japanese, English, Vietnamese, Malay, Spanish, Polish, Thai) 
•   Remote monitoring and group training system (real-time VR monitoring, help request, screen sharing, recording, streaming quality control) 
•   Debriefing system (training log review, instructor questions, LMS integration, learner reflection)
